answer: Proof of burn resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to destroy verifiable tokens at provably unspendable addresses. An attacker cannot deploy a zephyr of fake identities without incurring unrecoverable monetary losses, driving their cost efficiency to a nadir. Gateways isolate uncertified traffic within an unindexed lagoon of untrusted peers until burn proofs confirm. However, permanently incinerating capital excludes underfunded agents from the market.
